tonight: Last day we drive on Crete — Elounda to Heraklion, then turn in the car.
tomorrow: On foot in Heraklion — Saint Minas, old town, no rental keys.

lines.text: Why are you yelling at me?
I’m enjoying my day here, why are you yelling at me? I don’t make the rules, that’s your problem.
